main_info.name: Information Technology University
main_info.description: Established in 2012, Information Technology University (ITU) is a research-oriented public university in Lahore, Pakistan, offering undergraduate and graduate programs in engineering, computer science, business, and humanities.
main_info.verification_note: Identity fields sourced from resources/rankings_pk.json registry.

undergraduate.name: BS Artificial Intelligence
undergraduate.scholarships_info: Top 3 Merit Scholarship, CGPA Merit Scholarship, Honhaar Undergraduate Scholarship, PEEF, HEC Need Based, ITU Employee Scholarship
undergraduate.career_prospects: Agriculture, defense, healthcare, governance, transportation, e-commerce, finance, and education sectors
undergraduate.summary_3_lines:
The program imparts in-depth knowledge to transform complex scenarios into actionable decisions.
It focuses on utilizing knowledge, vision, language, and large databases to enhance human capabilities.
The curriculum includes machine learning, neural networks, computer vision, and natural language processing.

eligibility_requirements.aggregate_formula: Academic Record 50% (Matric/O-Level 15% + Inter part I/Inter/A-Level 35%) + Admission Test/SAT-I/USAT 50%

graduate.name: MS Computer Engineering
graduate.department: Department of Computer and Software Engineering
graduate.scholarships_info: Top 3 Merit Scholarship, CGPA Merit Scholarship, Graduate Student Fellowship, ITU Graduate Discount
graduate.career_prospects: R&D, Industrial Automation, Robotics, Multimedia, Sensing, and Artificial Intelligence
courses_taught: Cloud Computing with Big Data Applications
Image Processing Methodologies for Remote Sensing Data
Tools and Techniques for Data Science
graduate.summary_3_lines:
Focuses on cutting-edge technologies like Hardware Design, Embedded IoT, and Artificial Intelligence.
Prepares professionals for leading roles in engineering and scientific industry teams.
Requires 30 credit hours including coursework and a research thesis.

postgraduate_and_phd.name: PhD Computer Science
postgraduate_and_phd.scholarships_info: Pre-Doctoral Fellowship Program provides PKR 80,000 to 90,000 per month for 4 years with a tuition fee waiver.
postgraduate_and_phd.summary_3_lines:
The program emphasizes scholarly proficiency and the capacity for independent, original investigation.
Students must prepare a detailed research proposal and defend original research that contributes to their field.
The curriculum aims to provide a technically oriented education covering the discipline's theoretical foundations.

eligibility_requirements.minimum_marks_percentage: 60% or 1st division in annual system, or CGPA of 3.0
